results.content: # August 22-24, 2025 | West Lafayette, Indiana Purdue Supply Chain and Operations Management Conference Speakers & Participants. Featuring leading voices in operations management, the 2025 Purdue Supply Chain and Operations Management Conference program highlights research advancing the field amid rapid technological change, data-driven decision-making, and global challenges. Keynote Speakers Featured Faculty Postdocs & Students. Opening remarks will be delivered by Jim Bullard, the inaugural Dr. Samuel R. Allen Dean of the reimagined Mitch Daniels School of Business at Purdue University. A former president of the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis and a distinguished economist, scholar, and leader, Dean Bullard brings extensive experience in monetary policy, macroeconomic research, and academic leadership. Dauch Distinguished Chair in Manufacturing & Operations Management at Purdue University. Dr. Shanthikumar is a leading scholar in stochastic modeling and decision-making under uncertainty. To honor his enduring impact on the field, a special document filled with memories and tributes from friends and colleagues has been created, celebrating his remarkable career, mentorship, and the lasting inspiration he has provided to generations of scholars.
